pollution-human-health-synergism.alt: A bar chart of the percent of lab mice with lung damage after 30 days (invented data): 2% with no pollutant, 10% with pollutant A alone, 8% with pollutant B alone and 40% with A and B together. A dashed line at 18% marks what the two separate effects would add to; the bar for both together is far above it, which is synergism.
